analysis: Exploratory external-response test of the prespecified 38-gene score

response_source.response_metric: CTRP cpdAUC; not directly comparable in scale to GDSC2 AUC

expression_source.transform: log2(TPM + 1), gene-wise z-score across all 1,019 samples
expression_source.score: unweighted mean of the 38 gene-wise z-scores

identity_crosswalk.stable_model_id: Sanger Cell Model Passport ID recorded by Cellosaurus

primary_test.inferential_status: exploratory and underpowered; not confirmatory or clinically predictive

interpretation: This is an exploratory association using an independent drug-response screen but the same CCLE expression cohort. The small Neuroblastoma sample cannot confirm a biomarker or support clinical inference.
